meaning.en: Petty theft; also sneaky, disreputable behaviour (including illicit affairs).
meaning.zh: 指偷东西的小偷小摸行为，也指不正当的男女关系或见不得人的勾当。

examples.zh: 他年轻时不学好，整天偷鸡摸狗。
examples.en: In his youth he went to the bad and spent his days pilfering.

examples.zh: 别跟那帮偷鸡摸狗的人来往。
examples.en: Don't mix with that crowd of petty crooks.

pinyin: dǎ zhǒng liǎn chōng pàng zi
literal: slap · swollen · face · pass for · fat man
natural: put on a show beyond one's means

meaning.en: To slap one's own face until it swells to pass for a plump man; to keep up appearances beyond one's means.
meaning.zh: 把脸打肿，冒充胖子；比喻为了面子硬撑，装出自己做不到的样子。

equivalents: keep up appearances beyond one's means
put on a false show of wealth

examples.zh: 他没多少钱，还打肿脸充胖子请大家吃大餐。
examples.en: He hasn't much money, yet put on a show by treating everyone to a banquet.

examples.zh: 量力而行，别打肿脸充胖子。
examples.en: Live within your means; don't put on a show.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语，常用于劝告。

natural: fail to see the wood for the trees

meaning.en: Blocked from seeing the big picture by a trivial thing in front of one.
meaning.zh: 一片树叶挡住了眼睛，就看不见泰山；比喻被局部或暂时的现象所蒙蔽，看不到全局。

equivalents: can't see the wood for the trees

examples.zh: 不要因为一次失败就一叶障目，否定全部努力。
examples.en: Don't be blinded by one failure into dismissing all your effort.

examples.zh: 看问题要全面，免得一叶障目。
examples.en: Look at problems from all angles, so as not to miss the bigger picture.

story.en: From the Heguanzi: 'A leaf before the eyes hides Mount Tai' (一叶蔽目，不见泰山).

usage.en: Predicate; often 一叶障目，不见泰山.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“一叶障目，不见泰山”。

literal: polish like jade · you · into · success

meaning.en: Hardship polishes a person as jade is polished, helping them succeed.
meaning.zh: 像琢磨玉石一样，使你成材；指通过艰难困苦的磨炼而获得成功。

equivalents: hardship is the whetstone of success

examples.zh: 人生的磨难，正是玉汝于成的过程。
examples.en: The trials of life are precisely the process by which one is made.

examples.zh: 他相信艰苦的环境会玉汝于成。
examples.en: He believed that a hard environment would shape him for success.

story.en: Zhang Zai's 'Western Inscription': 'Poverty and sorrow are what will polish you into success' (贫贱忧戚，庸玉汝于成也).
story.zh: 张载《西铭》：“富贵福泽，将厚吾之生也；贫贱忧戚，庸玉汝于成也。”

meaning.en: Completely alone, with no family or companions.
meaning.zh: 孤单一个人，没有亲人伴侣。

examples.zh: 他孑然一身，漂泊异乡多年。
examples.en: Alone in the world, he drifted in a foreign land for years.

examples.zh: 老人孑然一身，靠邻居照顾。
examples.en: The old man is on his own and relies on neighbours.

meaning.en: Every frown and smile; every little expression.
meaning.zh: 一皱眉，一微笑，指人的每一个细微的表情。

examples.zh: 她的一颦一笑都牵动着他的心。
examples.en: Her every smile and frown tugged at his heart.

examples.zh: 演员的一颦一笑都十分传神。
examples.en: Every expression of the actor was vivid and expressive.

meaning.en: To disregard something entirely, especially one's own safety or interests.
meaning.zh: 不把它放在考虑之中，多指不顾个人生死利害。

examples.zh: 消防员把个人安危置之度外，冲进火场。
examples.en: The firefighters disregarded their own safety and rushed into the fire.

examples.zh: 他把得失置之度外，一心做研究。
examples.en: Putting gain and loss aside, he devoted himself to research.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“把……置之度外”。

meaning.en: A grievance or false charge that has not been cleared.
meaning.zh: 没有得到洗清的冤屈。

examples.zh: 经过多年申诉，他终于洗清了不白之冤。
examples.en: After years of appeals he finally cleared his name.

examples.zh: 她含着不白之冤离开了公司。
examples.en: She left the company under an unjust cloud.

usage.en: Object; often 蒙受/洗清不白之冤.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“蒙受/洗清不白之冤”。

meaning.en: Timid and afraid of getting into trouble.
meaning.zh: 胆子小，遇事害怕，不敢担当。

examples.zh: 他胆小怕事，从不敢提意见。
examples.en: He's timid and never dares to voice an opinion.

examples.zh: 遇到这种事不能胆小怕事。
examples.en: Don't be a coward when something like this happens.

literal: expel · the old · take in · the new
natural: shed the old and take in the new

meaning.en: To get rid of the stale and absorb the fresh.
meaning.zh: 吐出浊气，吸进新鲜空气；比喻扬弃旧的、吸收新的。

equivalents: shed the old, take in the new

examples.zh: 一个健康的组织需要不断吐故纳新。
examples.en: A healthy organisation needs to keep renewing itself.

examples.zh: 人体新陈代谢，吐故纳新。
examples.en: The body metabolises, expelling the old and taking in the new.

story.en: Zhuangzi: breathing exercises of 'exhaling the old and inhaling the new' (吹呴呼吸，吐故纳新) as practised by those who nurture the body.
story.zh: 《庄子》：“吹呴呼吸，吐故纳新，熊经鸟申，为寿而已矣。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

meaning.en: Attendants of the immortals in legend; now an attractive young pair.
meaning.zh: 原指道教中侍奉仙人的童男童女，现多比喻天真可爱的青年男女。

examples.zh: 婚礼上这对新人如同金童玉女。
examples.en: The couple at the wedding looked like a perfect pair.

examples.zh: 画上的金童玉女栩栩如生。
examples.en: The golden boy and jade girl in the painting looked lifelike.

meaning.en: To seek out and welcome able and virtuous people.
meaning.zh: 招揽、接纳有才能的人。

examples.zh: 公司正在大力招贤纳士。
examples.en: The company is recruiting talent in earnest.

examples.zh: 历代明君都重视招贤纳士。
examples.en: Wise rulers through the ages valued attracting talented people.

pinyin: chū yū ní ér bù rǎn
literal: emerge from · mud · yet · not · stained

meaning.en: To stay unspoiled even when surrounded by corruption.
meaning.zh: 从污泥中长出却不被污染；比喻身处污浊环境而保持清白。

equivalents: remain pure in a corrupt environment

examples.zh: 他在复杂的环境中出淤泥而不染，始终清廉。
examples.en: In a complicated environment he stayed pure, always incorruptible.

examples.zh: 莲花出淤泥而不染，是君子的象征。
examples.en: The lotus rises from the mud unstained, a symbol of the gentleman.

story.en: Zhou Dunyi's essay 'On Loving the Lotus' praises the lotus: 'It grows from the mud yet is unstained, and is washed by clear ripples yet not showy.'
story.zh: 周敦颐《爱莲说》：“予独爱莲之出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖。”

usage.en: Often paired with 濯清涟而不妖.
usage.zh: 常与“濯清涟而不妖”连用。

antonyms: 常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋

meaning.en: To surrender national rights and bring disgrace on the country.
meaning.zh: 丧失国家的主权，使国家蒙受耻辱。

examples.zh: 清政府签订了许多丧权辱国的条约。
examples.en: The Qing government signed many treaties that sacrificed the country's sovereignty.

examples.zh: 他们反对任何丧权辱国的协议。
examples.en: They oppose any agreement that humiliates the nation.

usage.en: Usually attributive: 丧权辱国的条约.
usage.zh: 多作定语，如“丧权辱国的条约”。

meaning.en: Saying something that does not come from the heart.
meaning.zh: 说的话不是发自内心的。

examples.zh: 他嘴上道歉，却显得言不由衷。
examples.en: He apologised but seemed insincere.

examples.zh: 这些客套话听起来言不由衷。
examples.en: Those polite phrases sounded hollow.

meaning.en: To stop crying and break into a smile.
meaning.zh: 止住眼泪，露出笑容，形容转悲为喜。

equivalents: break into a smile through one's tears

examples.zh: 妈妈给她买了新玩具，她立刻破涕为笑。
examples.en: Mum bought her a new toy and she smiled through her tears at once.

examples.zh: 听到好消息，他破涕为笑。
examples.en: On hearing the good news, he stopped crying and smiled.

meaning.en: Looking solemn and righteous, but usually hypocritical.
meaning.zh: 神态庄严的样子，现多讽刺假装正经的人。

examples.zh: 那个道貌岸然的官员，背地里却贪污受贿。
examples.en: That sanctimonious official was secretly taking bribes.

examples.zh: 他表面道貌岸然，私下里却不是这样。
examples.en: He looks dignified, but in private he's quite different.

meaning.en: A deep blue sky as clean as if it had been washed.
meaning.zh: 碧蓝的天空像洗过一样干净。

examples.zh: 雨后初晴，碧空如洗。
examples.en: After the rain it cleared, and the sky was washed clean.

examples.zh: 秋日的天空碧空如洗，一朵云也没有。
examples.en: The autumn sky was washed clean, without a single cloud.

pinyin: liǔ àn huā míng yòu yī cūn
literal: willows · dark · flowers · bright · another · village

meaning.en: Just when the way seems blocked, a new prospect opens up.
meaning.zh: 在柳树浓密、花朵明艳处又出现一个村庄；比喻在困境中突然出现转机。

equivalents: when one door closes another opens
a way out appears at the darkest hour

examples.zh: 山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村，转机终于出现了。
examples.en: Just when it seemed there was no way out, a new path opened up.

examples.zh: 别灰心，说不定柳暗花明又一村。
examples.en: Don't lose heart; perhaps another opening lies ahead.

story.en: Lu You's poem 'Visiting a Village West of the Mountain': 'Mountains and rivers wind until the way seems lost; amid dark willows and bright flowers, another village appears.'
story.zh: 陆游《游山西村》：“山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村。”

usage.en: Often with 山重水复疑无路.
usage.zh: 常与“山重水复疑无路”连用。

meaning.en: Arrogant, extravagant and dissolute in lifestyle.
meaning.zh: 骄横奢侈，荒淫放纵。

examples.zh: 那些骄奢淫逸的贵族终于被推翻了。
examples.en: The decadent aristocrats were finally overthrown.

examples.zh: 骄奢淫逸是亡国的先兆。
examples.en: Extravagance and dissipation presage a nation's fall.

meaning.en: Loyal and steadfast, never changing.
meaning.zh: 忠诚坚定，始终不变。

examples.zh: 他们的爱情忠贞不渝。
examples.en: Their love is unswervingly faithful.

examples.zh: 战士对祖国忠贞不渝。
examples.en: The soldier is steadfastly loyal to the motherland.

antonyms: 婴儿饿肚皮——有奶便是娘

meaning.en: Kind-hearted and therefore unable to be firm or harsh.
meaning.zh: 心肠慈善，下不了狠手；多指对该严厉处理的事不忍心。

examples.zh: 对违纪的人不能心慈手软。
examples.en: One mustn't go soft on those who break discipline.

examples.zh: 她心慈手软，不忍心责骂孩子。
examples.en: She's too soft-hearted to scold the child.

usage.en: Predicate; often negated 不能心慈手软.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不能心慈手软”。

meaning.en: Famous everywhere.
meaning.zh: 名声传遍天下，非常有名。

examples.zh: 这位大师名满天下，弟子遍及各地。
examples.en: The master is famous everywhere, with pupils across the land.

examples.zh: 他靠一部小说名满天下。
examples.en: One novel made his name known everywhere.

meaning.en: Having all the main features, but on a small scale.
meaning.zh: 内容大体具备，只是规模或形状较小。

examples.zh: 这个园林具体而微，湖山亭阁一应俱全。
examples.en: The garden is a miniature version with lake, hill and pavilions all present.

examples.zh: 沙盘上的城市具体而微。
examples.en: The city on the sand table is a complete model in miniature.
